name: Missing bank details
description: Bank account number or IFSC is empty.

name: Duplicate time submission
description: More than one non-correction entry for the same employee and date; the later one is flagged.

name: Hours exceed period maximum
description: Regular plus overtime hours are above the pay group maximum.

name: Daily hours outlier
description: An original entry has more hours than the daily outlier threshold.

name: Duplicate allowance
description: More than one approved allowance of the same type for an employee and period.

name: Unapproved source in payroll input
description: The input counts source rows that are not approved.

name: Leave deduction applied twice
description: More than one approved unpaid_leave deduction for the same leave record.

name: Payroll totals do not reconcile
description: Stored totals differ from a recomputation from approved source rows, or net is not gross minus deductions.

name: Late time submission
description: Entry submitted after the pay period submission deadline.

name: Negative net pay
description: Net pay is below the configured minimum.

name: Ineligible allowance
description: Allowance type is not eligible for the employee or pay group.
